```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
```

```{r}
open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet") |> schema()
```

```{r}
open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet") |>
  filter(date_raw >= "2025-01-01") |>
  group_by(coin_id) |>
  summarise(avg_market_cap_usd = mean(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  arrange(desc(avg_market_cap_usd)) |>
  collect()
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
prices <- read_parquet("data/daily_prices.parquet")
metadata <- read_parquet("data/coin_metadata.parquet")
categories <- read_parquet("data/categories.parquet")

crypto <- prices |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(date_raw)) |>
  left_join(metadata, by = "coin_id") |>
  left_join(
    categories |> select(category_id, category_name, era_introduced),
    by = "category_id"
  )
```

```{r}
crypto |>
  group_by(date, category_name) |>
  summarise(category_market_cap = sum(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(category_name = forcats::fct_reorder(
    category_name,
    category_market_cap,
    .fun = median,
    .desc = TRUE
  )) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = category_market_cap, fill = category_name)) +
  geom_area(position = "fill") +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = as.Date("2022-05-07"), xmax = as.Date("2022-05-12"),
    ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "grey20", alpha = 0.18
  ) +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = as.Date("2022-11-08"), xmax = as.Date("2022-11-11"),
    ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "grey20", alpha = 0.18
  ) +
  annotate(
    "label",
    x = as.Date("2022-05-09"), y = 0.97,
    label = "Luna / UST crash", size = 3
  ) +
  annotate(
    "label",
    x = as.Date("2022-11-09"), y = 0.97,
    label = "FTX collapse", size = 3
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "cividis") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent()) +
  labs(
    title = "How crypto market capitalization shifted across categories",
    subtitle = "Each band shows a category's share of total daily crypto market cap; all categories sum to 100%.",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Share of total market cap",
    fill = "Category",
    caption = "Source: daily_prices.parquet, coin_metadata.parquet, and categories.parquet; category totals are based on daily market capitalization."
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
metadata <- metadata |>
  mutate(launch_date_parsed = as_date(parse_date_time(
    launch_date,
    orders = c("B d, Y", "Y-m-d")
  )))

metadata |>
  select(coin_id, coin_name, launch_date, launch_date_parsed) |>
  arrange(launch_date_parsed)
```

```{r}
prices |>
  filter(coin_id == "btc") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = as.Date(date_raw), y = price_usd)) +
  geom_line(color = "darkorange", linewidth = 0.8) +
  labs(
    title = "Bitcoin daily price",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Price (USD)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
